summary.title: Text Rendering and Clipping Operations
summary.long_summary: The provided content enumerates various text rendering and clipping techniques. It includes simple operations such as filling text, stroking text, and performing both fill and stroke in sequence. Additionally, it covers the creation of clipping paths from text, with variations that combine filling, stroking, or both before adding the text to the clipping path. The list also specifies HTML-specific rendering methods: filling text, stroking text, and filling then stroking text. Each paragraph represents a distinct operation, illustrating how text can be rendered and used as a clipping mask in different contexts.
